method: 34 mandatory chapter facts mapped to blank-form fields before examining candidate outputs. 23 mapped facts measure positive-only coverage. Eligible packets were anonymized and scored by an independent agent for both answer meaning and locatable evidence. A candidate may contain several complementary pieces from the same field. No negative field key or official field judgments exist for these three forms.

runs.release-transfer-local: Product registered-field path with stored primary readings and a local qwen3:8b review stand-in for previously unseen review requests. One invalid local review used the product fallback.
